approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: Email From, To and Cc addresses containing compact workflow-like text currently create false RFI or Submittal references.
Keep Subject, current body and quoted-history references while excluding routing-neutral From, To, Cc and Date headers from relationship extraction.
Reuse the existing parser and workflow index; add no dependency, semantic inference, mailbox access or model call.
Offline parser and API regressions, specification sync and every bounded task context pack passed before completion.
title: Exclude email address workflow references
objective: Prevent routing-neutral email address headers from creating false RFI or Submittal workflow groups while retaining their visible evidence and all content-bearing references.
